Perfect! I now have a comprehensive understanding of the entire codebase. Let me provide you with a complete summary.

## Complete Codebase Analysis

### 1. PROJECT STRUCTURE

The project is a WikiTok application - a TikTok-style interface for exploring random Wikipedia articles. The directory structure is:

```
frontend/
├── src/
│   ├── components/          # React components
│   ├── contexts/            # React context providers
│   ├── hooks/               # Custom React hooks
│   ├── stories/             # Storybook component stories
│   ├── styles/              # Component-specific CSS
│   ├── assets/              # Static assets and animations
│   ├── types/               # TypeScript type definitions
│   ├── main.tsx             # Entry point
│   ├── App.tsx              # Root component
│   ├── index.css            # Global styles
│   ├── languages.ts         # Language configuration
│   └── vite-env.d.ts        # Vite type definitions
├── .storybook/              # Storybook configuration
├── public/                  # Public static assets
├── vite.config.ts           # Vite configuration
├── tsconfig.json            # TypeScript configuration
├── package.json             # Dependencies
├── index.html               # HTML entry point
└── eslint.config.js         # ESLint configuration
```

### 2. ENTRY POINT (main.tsx)

Located at `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/main.tsx`

- Creates React root and mounts app to `#root` element
- Wraps app with `LikedArticlesProvider` context
- Uses React 18's `StrictMode` for development warnings

### 3. APP.TSX (Root Component)

Located at `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/App.tsx`

**Key Features:**
- TikTok-style infinite scrolling interface with snap-scroll
- Fixed header with "WikiTok" logo that reloads page on click
- Fixed top-right controls: About, Likes, Language selector buttons
- Two modals: About modal and Liked Articles modal
- Infinite scroll using IntersectionObserver API
- Export functionality for liked articles as JSON
- Vercel Analytics integration

**State Management:**
- `showAbout`: Boolean for About modal visibility
- `showLikes`: Boolean for Liked Articles modal visibility
- `articles`: Array of Wikipedia articles from `useWikiArticles` hook
- `likedArticles`: Array of liked articles from context
- `searchQuery`: Search input for filtering liked articles

### 4. PROVIDERS & CONTEXTS

#### **LikedArticlesContext** 
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/contexts/LikedArticlesContext.tsx`

**Features:**
- Manages liked articles state
- **Browser State**: Uses `localStorage.getItem("likedArticles")` for persistence
- Context methods:
  - `toggleLike(article)`: Add/remove article from likes
  - `isLiked(pageid)`: Check if article is liked
  - `likedArticles`: Array of liked articles
- **Portal Usage**: Renders a heart animation using CSS animation at fixed position when an article is liked
- Animation triggered via `showHeart` state with 800ms timeout
- Uses `lucide-react` Heart icon for animation

### 5. HOOKS & DATA FETCHING

#### **useWikiArticles**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/hooks/useWikiArticles.ts`

**Data Fetching:**
- Fetches random Wikipedia articles via Wikipedia API
- Uses `currentLanguage.api` endpoint with URLSearchParams
- Fetches 20 articles at a time with parameters:
  - `action`: "query"
  - `generator`: "random"
  - `prop`: "extracts|info|pageimages"
  - `exintro`: "1", `exsentences`: "5"
  - `piprop`: "thumbnail", `pithumbsize`: "800"
- **Image Preloading**: Uses `preloadImage()` helper that creates Image elements to preload images before display
- Implements buffer system for smooth pagination
- Filters articles ensuring they have thumbnail, URL, and extract

**State Management:**
- `articles`: Currently displayed articles
- `loading`: Loading state
- `buffer`: Preloaded articles ready to display
- Uses `useLocalization()` to get current language for API selection

#### **useLocalization**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/hooks/useLocalization.ts`

**Browser State Reads:**
- **localStorage**: `localStorage.getItem("lang")` to retrieve saved language preference
- **localStorage**: `localStorage.setItem("lang", currentLanguage.id)` to persist language
- Returns initial language from LANGUAGES array or saved preference
- `setLanguage()` triggers page reload when language changes

### 6. ALL COMPONENTS

#### **WikiCard**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/WikiCard.tsx`

```typescript
interface WikiArticle {
    title: string;
    displaytitle: string;  // Language-variant title
    extract: string;
    pageid: number;
    url: string;
    thumbnail: {
        source: string;
        width: number;
        height: number;
    };
}
```

**Features:**
- Full-screen article card component
- Double-click to toggle like
- Image lazy loading with loading state
- Share functionality via native Web Share API or clipboard fallback
- Like button with heart icon
- Read more link to Wikipedia article
- Gradient overlay on image
- Responsive image loading with error handling

**Browser APIs:**
- `navigator.share()` for Web Share API
- `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` for clipboard fallback

#### **LanguageSelector**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector.tsx`

**Features:**
- Dropdown menu with 56 languages
- Click-outside detection for closing dropdown
- Supports multilingual Wikipedia access
- Uses language flags from external SVG CDN

#### **Article & ArticleList**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/Article.tsx`
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/ArticleList.tsx`

- Reusable article display component
- Accessibility features: `role="article"`, aria labels
- List component with keyboard navigation (Enter/Space keys)
- Used in stories/examples

### 7. CSS FILES

#### **Global Styles - index.css**
- Tailwind CSS import with `@import "tailwindcss"`
- Hides scrollbar on `.hide-scroll` class
- Prevents overscroll behavior

#### **Heart Animation - assets/heartAnimation.css**
- `@keyframes heart-pop`: Scales from 0 to 1 and back to 0, fades out
- Animation duration: 0.5s ease-out
- Positioned fixed at top 20% of viewport
- Width: 100% for center alignment

#### **Article Styles - styles/Article.css**
- `.article-container`: Margin, padding, focus outline
- `.article-title`: Bottom margin
- `.article-image`: Max-width 100%, auto height
- `.article-content`: Line-height 1.6

#### **Story CSS Files**
- `button.css`: Storybook button styles (primary/secondary, sizes)
- `header.css`: Storybook header layout and spacing
- `page.css`: Storybook page layout, typography, tips styling

### 8. PORTAL USAGE

The app implements a custom portal pattern (not using ReactDOM.createPortal):
- **Heart Animation**: Rendered as div with fixed positioning in LikedArticlesContext
- Rendered conditionally at context level to appear above all content
- Displays Heart icon from lucide-react with animation

### 9. ROUTER SETUP

**No Router**: This is a single-page application without React Router. All navigation is:
- Modal-based (About, Likes modals)
- External links to Wikipedia articles
- Window reload via WikiTok button
- Language change triggers full page reload

### 10. STORYBOOK CONFIGURATION

**Main Config** - `.storybook/main.ts`:
- Stories pattern: `../src/**/*.stories.@(js|jsx|mjs|ts|tsx)` and MDX files
- Addons: Chromatic, Vitest, A11y, Docs, Onboarding
- Framework: `@storybook/react-vite`

**Preview** - `.storybook/preview.tsx`:
- Control matchers for color and date inputs
- A11y addon with `test: 'todo'` mode

**Story Files**:
- `Button.stories.ts`: Primary, Secondary, Large, Small variants
- `Header.stories.ts`: LoggedIn, LoggedOut states
- `Page.stories.ts`: LoggedOut and LoggedIn with interaction testing

**Vitest Integration** (vite.config.ts):
- Storybook addon vitest plugin configured
- Playwright browser testing with mobile viewport (393x852)
- Mobile user agent simulation when `STORYBOOK_TEST_SCREENSHOTS=true`

### 11. PACKAGE.JSON DEPENDENCIES

**Key Dependencies:**
- `react` & `react-dom`: ^18.3.1
- `tailwindcss`: ^4.0.3 (with vite plugin and postcss)
- `lucide-react`: ^0.474.0 (icon library)
- `@vercel/analytics`: ^1.4.1

**Dev Dependencies:**
- Storybook: 10.4.0-alpha.17 (with vitest and a11y addons)
- Chromatic: 5.2.0-next.0
- Vitest: ^4.1.2
- Playwright: ^1.58.2
- ESLint & TypeScript: Latest versions
- Vite: ^6.0.5
- vite-plugin-pwa: ^0.21.1

### 12. TYPESCRIPT CONFIG

**tsconfig.app.json**:
- Target: ES2020
- Lib: ES2020, DOM, DOM.Iterable
- Module: ESNext
- JSX: react-jsx
- Strict mode enabled
- No unused locals/parameters
- No falthrough cases

### 13. EXISTING TESTS

**Test Framework**: Vitest with Storybook addon
- Configured for browser testing with Playwright
- Mobile viewport simulation (iPhone 17)
- Tests defined in `.stories.ts` files using `play()` function
- Example: Page.stories.ts has LoggedIn story with interaction test checking button visibility

**Scripts**:
- `vitest:storybook`: Run Storybook vitest project
- No standalone unit or integration tests beyond story tests

### 14. LANGUAGES CONFIGURATION

Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/languages.ts`

56 languages supported with:
- `id`: Language code
- `name`: Display name
- `flag`: SVG flag URL from hatscripts.github.io
- `api`: Wikipedia API endpoint
- `article`: Article URL pattern

Examples: English, Arabic, Bengali, Catalan, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Chinese (9 variants), Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Russian, etc.

### 15. PWA CONFIGURATION

Configured via vite-plugin-pwa:
- Name: "WikiTok"
- Start URL: "/"
- Display: "standalone"
- Manifest includes wiki-logo.svg icon
- Auto-update service worker
- Max file size for caching: 5MB
- Theme color: #000000 (black)
- Background color: #ffffff (white)

---

### 1. PROJECT STRUCTURE

The project is a WikiTok application - a TikTok-style interface for exploring random Wikipedia articles. The directory structure is:

```
frontend/

│   ├── hooks/               # Custom React hooks

│   ├── types/               # TypeScript type definitions
│   ├── main.tsx             # Entry point
│   ├── App.tsx              # Root component
│   ├── index.css            # Global styles
│   ├── languages.ts         # Language configuration
│   └── vite-env.d.ts        # Vite type definitions
├── .storybook/              # Storybook configuration
├── public/                  # Public static assets
├── vite.config.ts           # Vite configuration
├── tsconfig.json            # TypeScript configuration
├── package.json             # Dependencies
├── index.html               # HTML entry point
└── eslint.config.js         # ESLint configuration
```

### 2. ENTRY POINT (main.tsx)

Located at `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/main.tsx`

- Creates React root and mounts app to `#root` element
- Wraps app with `LikedArticlesProvider` context
- Uses React 18's `StrictMode` for development warnings

### 3. APP.TSX (Root Component)

Located at `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/App.tsx`

**Key Features:**
- TikTok-style infinite scrolling interface with snap-scroll
- Fixed header with "WikiTok" logo that reloads page on click
- Fixed top-right controls: About, Likes, Language selector buttons
- Two modals: About modal and Liked Articles modal
- Infinite scroll using IntersectionObserver API
- Export functionality for liked articles as JSON
- Vercel Analytics integration

**State Management:**
- `showAbout`: Boolean for About modal visibility
- `showLikes`: Boolean for Liked Articles modal visibility
- `articles`: Array of Wikipedia articles from `useWikiArticles` hook
- `likedArticles`: Array of liked articles from context
- `searchQuery`: Search input for filtering liked articles

### 4. PROVIDERS & CONTEXTS

#### **LikedArticlesContext** 
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/contexts/LikedArticlesContext.tsx`

**Features:**
- Manages liked articles state
- **Browser State**: Uses `localStorage.getItem("likedArticles")` for persistence
- Context methods:
  - `toggleLike(article)`: Add/remove article from likes
  - `isLiked(pageid)`: Check if article is liked
  - `likedArticles`: Array of liked articles
- **Portal Usage**: Renders a heart animation using CSS animation at fixed position when an article is liked
- Animation triggered via `showHeart` state with 800ms timeout
- Uses `lucide-react` Heart icon for animation

### 5. HOOKS & DATA FETCHING

#### **useWikiArticles**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/hooks/useWikiArticles.ts`

**Data Fetching:**
- Fetches random Wikipedia articles via Wikipedia API
- Uses `currentLanguage.api` endpoint with URLSearchParams
- Fetches 20 articles at a time with parameters:
  - `action`: "query"
  - `generator`: "random"
  - `prop`: "extracts|info|pageimages"
  - `exintro`: "1", `exsentences`: "5"
  - `piprop`: "thumbnail", `pithumbsize`: "800"
- **Image Preloading**: Uses `preloadImage()` helper that creates Image elements to preload images before display
- Implements buffer system for smooth pagination
- Filters articles ensuring they have thumbnail, URL, and extract

**State Management:**
- `articles`: Currently displayed articles
- `loading`: Loading state
- `buffer`: Preloaded articles ready to display
- Uses `useLocalization()` to get current language for API selection

#### **useLocalization**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/hooks/useLocalization.ts`

**Browser State Reads:**
- **localStorage**: `localStorage.getItem("lang")` to retrieve saved language preference
- **localStorage**: `localStorage.setItem("lang", currentLanguage.id)` to persist language
- Returns initial language from LANGUAGES array or saved preference
- `setLanguage()` triggers page reload when language changes

### 6. ALL COMPONENTS

#### **WikiCard**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/WikiCard.tsx`

```typescript
interface WikiArticle {
    title: string;
    displaytitle: string;  // Language-variant title
    extract: string;
    pageid: number;
    url: string;
    thumbnail: {
        source: string;
        width: number;
        height: number;
    };
}
```

**Features:**
- Full-screen article card component
- Double-click to toggle like
- Image lazy loading with loading state
- Share functionality via native Web Share API or clipboard fallback
- Like button with heart icon
- Read more link to Wikipedia article
- Gradient overlay on image
- Responsive image loading with error handling

**Browser APIs:**
- `navigator.share()` for Web Share API
- `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` for clipboard fallback

#### **LanguageSelector**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector.tsx`

**Features:**
- Dropdown menu with 56 languages
- Click-outside detection for closing dropdown
- Supports multilingual Wikipedia access
- Uses language flags from external SVG CDN

#### **Article & ArticleList**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/Article.tsx`
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/ArticleList.tsx`

- Reusable article display component
- Accessibility features: `role="article"`, aria labels
- List component with keyboard navigation (Enter/Space keys)
- Used in stories/examples

### 7. CSS FILES

#### **Global Styles - index.css**
- Tailwind CSS import with `@import "tailwindcss"`
- Hides scrollbar on `.hide-scroll` class
- Prevents overscroll behavior

#### **Heart Animation - assets/heartAnimation.css**
- `@keyframes heart-pop`: Scales from 0 to 1 and back to 0, fades out
- Animation duration: 0.5s ease-out
- Positioned fixed at top 20% of viewport
- Width: 100% for center alignment

#### **Article Styles - styles/Article.css**
- `.article-container`: Margin, padding, focus outline
- `.article-title`: Bottom margin
- `.article-image`: Max-width 100%, auto height
- `.article-content`: Line-height 1.6

#### **Story CSS Files**
- `button.css`: Storybook button styles (primary/secondary, sizes)
- `header.css`: Storybook header layout and spacing
- `page.css`: Storybook page layout, typography, tips styling

### 8. PORTAL USAGE

The app implements a custom portal pattern (not using ReactDOM.createPortal):
- **Heart Animation**: Rendered as div with fixed positioning in LikedArticlesContext
- Rendered conditionally at context level to appear above all content
- Displays Heart icon from lucide-react with animation

### 9. ROUTER SETUP

**No Router**: This is a single-page application without React Router. All navigation is:
- Modal-based (About, Likes modals)
- External links to Wikipedia articles
- Window reload via WikiTok button
- Language change triggers full page reload

### 12. TYPESCRIPT CONFIG

**tsconfig.app.json**:
- Target: ES2020
- Lib: ES2020, DOM, DOM.Iterable
- Module: ESNext
- JSX: react-jsx
- Strict mode enabled
- No unused locals/parameters

### 13. EXISTING TESTS

**Test Framework**: Vitest with Storybook addon
- Configured for browser testing with Playwright
- Mobile viewport simulation (iPhone 17)

- Example: Page.stories.ts has LoggedIn story with interaction test checking button visibility

**Scripts**:

- No standalone unit or integration tests beyond story tests

### 14. LANGUAGES CONFIGURATION

Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/languages.ts`

56 languages supported with:

## Analysis Summary

### Providers needed in preview:
- `LikedArticlesProvider` (wraps App in main.tsx)

### CSS to import:
- `../src/index.css` (global styles with Tailwind)

### Browser state reads:
- `localStorage.getItem("likedArticles")` in LikedArticlesContext
- `localStorage.getItem("lang")` in useLocalization

### Network requests:
- Wikipedia API: `https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?...` (and other language variants)


- Fetches random articles with extracts, page images, and other metadata

### Portal usage:
- Heart animation in LikedArticlesContext - rendered as a fixed div, not using createPortal
- No actual portal roots needed

### Components for stories:
1. **WikiCard** - main card component (needs LikedArticlesProvider)
2. **LanguageSelector** - dropdown with languages
3. **Article** - simple article display
4. **ArticleList** - list of articles
5. **App** - skip this since the codebase has actual pages

Wait, I need to reconsider. App is the main page here since there are no separate page components in this single-page application. So App effectively functions as the page component and I should include it. That gives me 5 stories total, but the instructions ask for up to 10 - I'm not finding additional components beyond these core ones.

Actually, looking at the instruction more carefully: "Write up to 10 story files, or fewer only if the codebase clearly has fewer meaningful targets." This codebase genuinely has just 5 meaningful components to document, so that's the right number. I can write multiple story variants for each component - WikiCard with different states like liked or loading, LanguageSelector in open and closed states, Article with and without images, ArticleList with various data scenarios, and App as the full application.

Now I need to set up the Storybook infrastructure. ## Complete Codebase Analysis

### 1. PROJECT STRUCTURE

The project is a WikiTok application - a TikTok-style interface for exploring random Wikipedia articles. The directory structure is:

```
frontend/
├── src/
│   ├── components/          # React components
│   ├── contexts/            # React context providers
│   ├── hooks/               # Custom React hooks
│   ├── stories/             # Storybook component stories
│   ├── styles/              # Component-specific CSS
│   ├── assets/              # Static assets and animations
│   ├── types/               # TypeScript type definitions
│   ├── main.tsx             # Entry point
│   ├── App.tsx              # Root component
│   ├── index.css            # Global styles
│   ├── languages.ts         # Language configuration
│   └── vite-env.d.ts        # Vite type definitions
├── .storybook/              # Storybook configuration
├── public/                  # Public static assets
├── vite.config.ts           # Vite configuration
├── tsconfig.json            # TypeScript configuration
├── package.json             # Dependencies
├── index.html               # HTML entry point
└── eslint.config.js         # ESLint configuration
```

### 2. ENTRY POINT (main.tsx)

Located at `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/main.tsx`

- Creates React root and mounts app to `#root` element
- Wraps app with `LikedArticlesProvider` context
- Uses React 18's `StrictMode` for development warnings

### 3. APP.TSX (Root Component)

Located at `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/App.tsx`

**Key Features:**
- TikTok-style infinite scrolling interface with snap-scroll
- Fixed header with "WikiTok" logo that reloads page on click
- Fixed top-right controls: About, Likes, Language selector buttons
- Two modals: About modal and Liked Articles modal
- Infinite scroll using IntersectionObserver API
- Export functionality for liked articles as JSON
- Vercel Analytics integration

**State Management:**
- `showAbout`: Boolean for About modal visibility
- `showLikes`: Boolean for Liked Articles modal visibility
- `articles`: Array of Wikipedia articles from `useWikiArticles` hook
- `likedArticles`: Array of liked articles from context
- `searchQuery`: Search input for filtering liked articles

### 4. PROVIDERS & CONTEXTS

#### **LikedArticlesContext** 
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/contexts/LikedArticlesContext.tsx`

**Features:**
- Manages liked articles state
- **Browser State**: Uses `localStorage.getItem("likedArticles")` for persistence
- Context methods:
  - `toggleLike(article)`: Add/remove article from likes
  - `isLiked(pageid)`: Check if article is liked
  - `likedArticles`: Array of liked articles
- **Portal Usage**: Renders a heart animation using CSS animation at fixed position when an article is liked
- Animation triggered via `showHeart` state with 800ms timeout
- Uses `lucide-react` Heart icon for animation

### 5. HOOKS & DATA FETCHING

#### **useWikiArticles**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/hooks/useWikiArticles.ts`

**Data Fetching:**
- Fetches random Wikipedia articles via Wikipedia API
- Uses `currentLanguage.api` endpoint with URLSearchParams
- Fetches 20 articles at a time with parameters:
  - `action`: "query"
  - `generator`: "random"
  - `prop`: "extracts|info|pageimages"
  - `exintro`: "1", `exsentences`: "5"
  - `piprop`: "thumbnail", `pithumbsize`: "800"
- **Image Preloading**: Uses `preloadImage()` helper that creates Image elements to preload images before display
- Implements buffer system for smooth pagination
- Filters articles ensuring they have thumbnail, URL, and extract

**State Management:**
- `articles`: Currently displayed articles
- `loading`: Loading state
- `buffer`: Preloaded articles ready to display
- Uses `useLocalization()` to get current language for API selection

#### **useLocalization**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/hooks/useLocalization.ts`

**Browser State Reads:**
- **localStorage**: `localStorage.getItem("lang")` to retrieve saved language preference
- **localStorage**: `localStorage.setItem("lang", currentLanguage.id)` to persist language
- Returns initial language from LANGUAGES array or saved preference
- `setLanguage()` triggers page reload when language changes

### 6. ALL COMPONENTS

#### **WikiCard**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/WikiCard.tsx`

```typescript
interface WikiArticle {
    title: string;
    displaytitle: string;  // Language-variant title
    extract: string;
    pageid: number;
    url: string;
    thumbnail: {
        source: string;
        width: number;
        height: number;
    };
}
```

**Features:**
- Full-screen article card component
- Double-click to toggle like
- Image lazy loading with loading state
- Share functionality via native Web Share API or clipboard fallback
- Like button with heart icon
- Read more link to Wikipedia article
- Gradient overlay on image
- Responsive image loading with error handling

**Browser APIs:**
- `navigator.share()` for Web Share API
- `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` for clipboard fallback

#### **LanguageSelector**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector.tsx`

**Features:**
- Dropdown menu with 56 languages
- Click-outside detection for closing dropdown
- Supports multilingual Wikipedia access
- Uses language flags from external SVG CDN

#### **Article & ArticleList**
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/Article.tsx`
Path: `/Users/yannbraga/open-source/storybook-eval/trials/2026-05-05T21-47-58Z-d16ff6d6/project/frontend/src/components/ArticleList.tsx`

- Accessibility features: `role="article"`, aria labels
- List component with keyboard navigation (Enter/Space keys)
- Used in stories/examples

- Prevents overscroll behavior

- `@keyframes heart-pop`: Scales from 0 to 1 and back to 0, fades out

- Positioned fixed at top 20% of viewport
- Width: 100% for center alignment
